_about: Single configuration file for the complete parametric aircraft (aircraft_sw.py).
Every geometric parameter of the wing, fuselage and tail is defined here, independently,
with its own allowed range [min, max]. Text parameters have a list of 'choices' or a 'pattern'.
The 'integration' block places the wing and tail on the fuselage. Tail arm, wing height and tail
position are derived from it automatically.
The 'constraints' list holds cross-component rules (proportions and fit). Each 'expr' may use
wing.<name>, fuselage.<name>, tail.<name>, integration.<name> and derived.<name>
(run 'python aircraft_sw.py --check' to see every derived value).
The model is only built when every value lies within its range and every constraint holds.
Units: mm and degrees. Coordinates: X aft from the nose tip, Y up, Z spanwise.

aspect_ratio.description: Span squared divided by the wing area

taper_ratio.description: Tip chord divided by the root chord

sweep_deg.description: Sweep of the reference chord line (+ = swept back)

sweep_ref.description: Chord fraction the sweep is measured on (0 = leading edge, 0.25 = quarter chord)

twist_deg.description: Tip twist relative to the root (negative = washout)

twist_axis.description: Chord fraction the sections are twisted about

n_stations.description: Loft sections from root to tip

naca.description: NACA 4-digit section (used when no airfoil file is set)

airfoil_file.description: Selig / Lednicer .dat file; empty = use the NACA section

n_points_per_surface.description: 0 = use the airfoil points as they are, 10-200 = cosine resampling

length_mm.description: Total length L, nose tip to tail end

max_height_mm.description: Maximum height H (without the canopy hump)

nose_frac.description: Nose length as a fraction of the fuselage length

tail_frac.description: Tail-cone length as a fraction of the fuselage length

nose_droop.description: Nose tip height relative to half the height (negative = below the centreline)

section_n_top.description: Superellipse exponent of the upper half (2 = ellipse, larger = boxier)

section_n_bottom.description: Superellipse exponent of the lower half (larger = flatter floor)

section_n_nose.description: Section exponent at the nose tip

section_n_tail.description: Section exponent at the tail end

canopy_start_frac.description: Start of the canopy / avionics hump as a fraction of the length

canopy_length_frac.description: Length of the hump as a fraction of the fuselage length

canopy_height_mm.description: Extra height at the hump peak (0 = no hump)

canopy_peak_pos.description: Peak position within the hump (0 = front, 1 = rear)

tail_end_width_mm.description: Width of the tail-end section (0 together with the height = pointed tail)

tail_upsweep.description: Tail-end centre height relative to half the height (+ = up)

tail_shape.description: 1 = smooth cubic taper, > 1 keeps the body full for longer

n_tail_stations.description: Loft sections in the tail cone

h_area_mm2.description: Fixed stabiliser area (0 = size it from the volume coefficient Vh)

v_area_mm2.description: Fixed fin area (0 = size it from the volume coefficient Vv)

h_aspect_ratio.description: Stabiliser aspect ratio (also used for the V-tail panels)

h_taper_ratio.description: Stabiliser tip chord divided by its root chord

v_taper_ratio.description: Fin tip chord divided by its root chord

v_tail_angle_deg.description: Panel angle of V, inverted-V and Y tails; 0 = automatic (Purser-Campbell), otherwise 15 to 60

stab_height_frac.description: Cruciform: stabiliser height as a fraction of the fin height

fin_below_frac.description: H-tail: share of each endplate fin below the stabiliser

ventral_fin_frac.description: Y-tail: share of the fin area carried by the ventral fin

fin_x_offset_mm.description: Move the fin(s) aft (+) or forward (-) from the default position

naca.description: Symmetric NACA 4-digit section for all tail surfaces

airfoil_file.description: .dat file used instead of the NACA section

n_points_per_surface.description: 0 = use the airfoil points as they are, 10-200 = cosine resampling

wing_x_frac.description: Wing root leading-edge position as a fraction of the fuselage length

wing_vertical_pos.description: -1 = low wing, 0 = mid wing, +1 = high wing (the root always stays inside the fuselage)

wing_incidence_deg.description: Wing root setting angle relative to the fuselage axis (+ = nose up)

tail_overhang_frac.description: How far the tail root trailing edge reaches past the fuselage end, as a fraction of the tail root chord (negative = ahead of the end)

tail_vertical_pos.description: Tail root height within the tail cone: -1 = lowest, 0 = middle, +1 = highest that still fits

constraints.name: fuselage_length_to_span
constraints.description: Fuselage length versus wing span (UAVs 0.45-0.8, light aircraft 0.7-0.9)

constraints.name: fuselage_width_to_span
constraints.description: Fuselage must not swallow too much of the wing span

constraints.name: fuselage_fineness
constraints.description: Fineness ratio: length over the equivalent diameter

constraints.name: fuselage_height_to_width
constraints.description: Cross-section aspect: height over width

constraints.name: fuselage_nose_plus_tail
constraints.description: Leaves a mid-body for the wing box

constraints.name: canopy_within_body
constraints.description: Hump ends before the tail cone region

constraints.name: canopy_height_ratio
constraints.description: Hump height vs fuselage height

constraints.name: tail_end_width_ratio
constraints.description: Tail-end section vs max section

constraints.name: tail_end_height_ratio
constraints.description: Tail-end section vs max section

constraints.name: wing_root_chord_to_length
constraints.description: Wing root chord vs fuselage length

constraints.name: wing_root_thickness_ratio
constraints.description: Wing root thickness must fit in the local fuselage height

constraints.name: wing_root_fit
constraints.description: Vertical room for the wing root inside the fuselage (< 0 = root sticks out)

constraints.name: wing_root_te_position
constraints.description: Wing root trailing edge stays ahead of the thin tail cone

constraints.name: wing_exposed_span
constraints.description: Share of the span outside the fuselage

constraints.name: tail_arm_to_mac
constraints.description: Tail arm in wing MACs (typical 2.5-4)

constraints.name: wing_tail_gap
constraints.description: Tail leading edge behind the wing trailing edge, in wing MACs

constraints.name: stab_span_to_wing_span
constraints.description: Tail span vs wing span

constraints.name: fin_height_to_fuselage
constraints.description: Vertical extent of the tail from its root (up or down) vs fuselage height

constraints.name: tail_root_fit
constraints.description: Vertical room for the tail root inside the tail cone (< 0 = does not fit)

constraints.name: tail_root_on_fuselage
constraints.description: Share of the tail root chord attached to the fuselage

constraints.name: tail_below_fuselage
constraints.description: How far tail surfaces hang below the fuselage bottom

constraints.name: tail_volume_h
constraints.description: Achieved over target Vh (always 1 when a fixed stabiliser area is given)

constraints.name: tail_volume_v
constraints.description: Achieved over target Vv (always 1 when a fixed fin area is given)
